items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: He made a couple of tours, made a few recordings. Panama Francis and his Savoy Sultans.

ctx.x: Yeah. But it was really nice. He made a couple of tours, made a few recordings. Panama Francis and his Savoy Sultans. Most of those guys that were in that band now are all passed away.
